title: Metro subway project marks first tunnel boring breakthrough

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos on Wednesday called the first tunnel boring machine (TBM) breakthrough of the Metro Manila Subway Project (MMSP) at Quezon Avenue station an important milestone in the construction of the country’s first-ever underground railway system.
